title: Ubisoft reports Q2 net bookings down 21% YoY to €388.9M, above €350.7M est., driven by Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced, as it overhauls its operations (Mauro Orru/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Mauro Orru / Wall Street Journal: Ubisoft reports Q2 net bookings down 21% YoY to €388.9M, above €350.7M est., driven by Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced, as it overhauls its operations — The videogame developer is looking to get its finances back on track following a major overhaul of its operations
